title: Nonlinear Controllability and the Propagation of Local Information: From the Kalman Family to Lie Brackets, Rotation Groups, and Reachable Subgroups
summary: This article develops a self-contained Lie-theoretic route from linear controllability to nonlinear controllability on matrix Lie groups. The organizing question is whether local algebraic information can be propagated into statements about reachable sets. The linear case supplies the model: the matrix exponential, Cayley-Hamilton theorem, trajectory formula and Kalman family B,AB,...,An-1B reduce controllability to finite-dimensional linear algebra.
